raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

The MiniMax-M3 AITER indexer selector now rejects index-head counts AITER has no kernels for. At attention TP=1 (4 index heads per rank), the server now fails at load with a clear error instead of crashing on the first decode step.

## Claims

- `aiter_indexer_unsupported_reason` accepts only 1 or 2 index heads, the counts AITER builds its MSA score kernels for (`SPARSE_DECODE_TABLE`/`SPARSE_PREFILL_TABLE`, unchanged from the `v0.1.24.post1` pin through AITER main).
- A new regression test in `test_minimax_m3.py` fails without the fix and passes with it.

## Validation

MI355 (gfx950). At TP=1, `amd/MiniMax-M3-MXFP4` crashed before the fix at the first forward with `pa_sparse_block_score_decode: no build for num_idx_heads=4`. With the fix it refuses to start with a configuration error. `tests/kernels/attention/test_minimax_m3.py` passed 10/10 runs.

At TP=2 the same AITER kernels run before and after. I ran 5 interleaved runs per column, each with a fresh server, using `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1` and the fp8 index cache. Values are mean ± sd.

| `vllm bench serve` (4096 in / 256 out, conc 16) | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Request throughput (req/s) | 2.366 ± 0.007 | 2.365 ± 0.009 |
| Mean TPOT (ms) | 18.83 ± 0.73 | 18.53 ± 0.86 |

| gsm8k (5-shot, n=1319) | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| strict-match | 0.8799 ± 0.0089 | 0.8708 ± 0.0089 |

The gsm8k difference is not significant (Welch p ≈ 0.14).

## Details

The selector only rejected head counts above the 16 MFMA columns, so 4 heads got through and failed inside AITER's kernel dispatch. A rejected config falls back to the platform-neutral indexer, which turns this case into a load-time error. TP ≥ 2 still gives each rank 1 or 2 heads, so it keeps the AITER path. The test asks the selector instead of naming an architecture, so it keeps working as more CDNA targets are added. No open PR fixes this. If #57909 (which moves this selector to `indexer_msa.py`) lands first, the guard belongs there.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to draft this change. Every line was reviewed by the submitter.

---

files.patch:
@@ -1833,6 +1833,35 @@ def unsupported_reason() -> str | None:
     assert reason is None or "AITER sparse PA attend" not in reason
 
 
+def test_aiter_indexer_rejects_unbuilt_index_heads(monkeypatch):
+    """AITER builds the MSA score kernels for 1 or 2 index heads only.
+
+    MiniMax-M3 has 4, so at attention TP=1 the indexer has to fall back at load
+    time rather than fail at the first forward.
+    """
+    import vllm.models.minimax_m3.amd.indexer_aiter as indexer_aiter_mod
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(indexer_aiter_mod.current_platform, "is_rocm", lambda: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        indexer_aiter_mod, "_minimax_m3_aiter_sparse_pa_requested", lambda: True
+    )
+
+    def unsupported_reason(num_index_heads: int) -> str | None:
+        return indexer_aiter_mod.aiter_indexer_unsupported_reason(
+            topk_blocks=TOPK,
+            sparse_block_size=BLOCK_SIZE,
+            num_index_heads=num_index_heads,
+            index_head_dim=HEAD_DIM,
+            indexer_kv_dtype="fp8",
+            max_model_len=8192,
+        )
+
+    if reason := unsupported_reason(2):
+        pytest.skip(f"AITER MSA indexer unavailable: {reason}")
+    reason = unsupported_reason(4)
+    assert reason is not None and "num_index_heads" in reason
+
+
 def test_aiter_consolidated_qknorm_enabled(monkeypatch):
     from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops

@@ -67,6 +67,8 @@
 MSA_SCORE_TYPE = "max"
 MSA_SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE = 128
 MSA_INDEX_HEAD_DIM = 128
+# Index head counts the score kernels are instantiated for.
+MSA_NUM_INDEX_HEADS = (1, 2)
 # Wave width the top-k is written against: it gives one lane per output slot and
 # reads the score row in wave-wide strips.
 WAVE_SIZE = 64
@@ -181,8 +183,11 @@ def aiter_indexer_unsupported_reason(
             f"needs index_head_dim={MSA_INDEX_HEAD_DIM}, "
             f"got index_head_dim={index_head_dim}"
         )
-    if num_index_heads > MFMA_COLS:
-        return f"num_index_heads={num_index_heads} exceeds the {MFMA_COLS} MFMA columns"
+    if num_index_heads not in MSA_NUM_INDEX_HEADS:
+        return (
+            f"needs num_index_heads in {MSA_NUM_INDEX_HEADS}, "
+            f"got num_index_heads={num_index_heads}"
+        )
     # A decode row's whole query shares one MFMA tile, one column per (token,
     # head) pair, so spec decode trades columns against the head count.
     if num_index_heads * max_decode_query_len > MFMA_COLS:

@@ -125,7 +125,9 @@ def minimax_m3_use_aiter_sparse_pa(
         raise ValueError(
             "MiniMax M3 AITER sparse paged attention requires "
             f"num_kv_heads == 1 per tensor-parallel rank, got {num_kv_heads}, "
-            "unless the indexer emits the attend's page table."
+            "unless the AITER indexer emits the attend's page table. It is not "
+            "in use here; the 'MiniMax M3 indexer: AITER unavailable' log line "
+            "says why."
         )
     return requested
